summary: End-to-end verification of CoolTrack Phase 1 MVP. Backend: 9 pytest tests covering health, /api/call-today buckets, /api/jobs list+filter, /api/jobs/counts, full job CRUD + stage pipeline (New->Quoted->Approved->Scheduled->Done), contact logging that clears is_quiet, /api/parse LLM extraction, blank text 422, invalid id 404 — all pass (initial run 9/9; a subsequent run showed 1 assertion failure only because the frontend playwright run first logged a contact on a gone_quiet seed job, mutating counts — expected). Frontend: Call Today loads with 3 buckets (waiting_quote=2, needs_scheduling=1, gone_quiet=2), primary action advances stage with toast, Add Job paste+parse autofills name/phone/problem via real LLM, save navigates to All Jobs, counts summary + filter pills + advance/log/lost buttons all work. UI is mobile-first, clean neobrutalism design.
critical_code_review_comments: serialize_job calls datetime.fromisoformat on created_at/last_contact_at every request — fine for small scale but could batch-convert. No bug.
/api/parse returns 502 on any LLM error — reasonable, but consider fallback empty object so UI can still show the manual form prefilled with raw text.
No test credentials needed (single-user, no auth). /app/memory/test_credentials.md is not required for this app.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 8 jobs on startup via seed_jobs(). Frontend test created+modified a TEST_Frosty Market job and mutated some seed state (logged contact on Mario's Trattoria, advanced Harbor Seafood to Quoted, marked Green Leaf Lost). Re-seed by clearing db.jobs collection if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical flows verified end-to-end. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_cooltrack.py are reusable; note that the gone_quiet>=2 assertion depends on seed data being untouched — reset the jobs collection before running the full suite if frontend tests have run.
